contentHtml:
Our seminar activities are held on Wednesdays during 4th and 5th periods, and in the 4th period, 3rd grade students read together from a reference book given by Prof. Katayama.
In addition, several of these sessions will include R exercises, where students will practice performing regression analysis, etc. using R.
In the fifth period, the 4th grade students will mainly present their thesis reports, and there will be an opportunity for questions at the end, which is expected to be a learning experience for the 3rd students as well.

(Accepting Double Degree)
name: Katayama Shota Seminar（P）（DD）
professorDescription: 高次元・大規模データに対する適切な理論や方法論の開発を目指して，スパースモデリング，ロバスト推測，因果推論，グラフィカルモデリングなどを研究しています．データ解析(経済分野に限らず)をしていると，もう少し融通の利く方法があればとか，何故これで上手くいったのかなど思うことが多々あります．新しい解析法の開発に興味がある方や，数理的に細かい部分が気になる方は一緒に勉強・研究しましょう．
